title.narrative: 224032 Targeted and Inclusive Emergency Response for DRC Refugees, prioritising girls, women, PWDs, and elders in Rugombo settlement

description.narrative: The response has been designed based on the gaps identified in the multi-sector needs assessment conducted on February 22 and led by UNHCR and WFP. The focus of this response is on providing integrated support that addresses the immediate basic needs, the mental health, safety, and dignity of refugees. Special attention is given to ensuring that vulnerable groups, including women, children, elders, and persons with disabilities, have access to cash assistance offering the flexibility to address their immediate needs, the provision of essential services such as food, clean water, sanitation, and protection. The rapid deployment of resources aims to mitigate immediate risks like malnutrition, waterborne diseases, and exposure to gender-based violence and child abuse. This approach ensures that targeted refugees, especially the most vulnerable, receive the necessary assistance and protection. The design of this response is informed by direct feedback from refugees, ensuring that their specific needs and priorities are addressed. Refugees have been consulted during the needs assessment to better understand their most urgent challenges they face. Their input has been integral in shaping the interventions, ensuring that they are context-specific, inclusive, and tailored to meet the diverse needs of the population.
